definitions.gloss: careless forgetfulness; absent-minded forgetting; slipping one's mind
definitions.explanation: Forgetting something due to carelessness or inattention, rather than intentional neglect. Often used to excuse minor lapses in memory.

examples.japanese: うっかり{忘|わす}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: I was late to the meeting because I carelessly forgot about it.

examples.japanese: うっかり{忘|わす}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I take notes to prevent absent-minded forgetting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、うっかり{忘|わす}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: As we get older, careless forgetting increases.

notes:
うっかり{忘|わす}れ combines ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧ (carelessly, absent-mindedly) with ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (forgetting).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be careless
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to make a careless mistake
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦{口|くち}を{滑|すべ}らせる→口を滑らせる：19678_kuchiwosuberaseru⟧: to let something slip

USAGE:
Often used as an excuse or explanation when something was unintentionally forgotten. The word emphasizes that the forgetting was not deliberate but due to momentary inattention.
